## Purpose
Files Prettier must not format.

## Settings that matter
node_modules, dist, .output, .vinxi, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, bun.lock, routeTree.gen.ts.

## Read by
Prettier (`npm run format`).

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
`routeTree.gen.ts` is generated by the router plugin and must not be reformatted.
